name: wall-fittings-editor-verify
description: WALL-FITTINGS in the room editor (EDITOR-LOCKSTEP): entering the living/dining room editor must show only THAT room's switches/sockets/DB box, scoped by fittingModel.ts:fittingsForRoom — never the whole flat's fittings floating around the isolated room. Run with SHOT_GPU=1.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: probe
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0, inst = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'wall-fittings') { n++; o.traverse(c => { if (c.isInstancedMesh) inst += c.count }) } }); console.log('[probe] editor fittings', JSON.stringify({ groups: n, instances: inst })) })()
